deployments_detail.use: AI-powered shopper tools (Simon Search, ShopSimon, Simon+) + AI analytics via Simon Innovation Group

Google Vertex AI used to enrich the ShopSimon online catalog: extracting and standardizing missing product attributes, generating alt text, and identifying non-compliant content across data aggregated from many retailers; enriched data feeds search (with Azure AI Search) and analytics (GA4 into BigQuery). [Google Cloud Vertex AI; implementation by Woolpert; Azure AI Search; BigQuery]

Machine-learning analytics models process consumer data (traffic patterns, purchase behavior) to surface opportunities and guide merchandising, leasing/location strategy, and customer engagement across the portfolio. [Simon (Innovation Group)]
HolidAI Gift Finder: in-mall staff ('elves') equipped with tablets running an AI gift-recommendation tool to help holiday shoppers find gifts, piloted during the 2023 holiday season. [Simon]

ShopSimon online marketplace AI shopping assistant: search-by-image, search-by-color, similar-item recommendations, and hyper-personalization to guide shoppers through the catalog. [Simon (ShopSimon)]
deployments_detail.value: 360+ participating retailers; 153 million annual website visits

deployments_detail.use: Simon Search digital search platform lets shoppers find in-stock products at stores inside a Simon center before visiting; launched 2022 and expanded across the portfolio. [Simon]

Quividi computer-vision audience & attention measurement platform deployed on Simon's digital out-of-home (DOOH) screens to measure real-time viewership, attention time, and shopper engagement. [Quividi]

Yext AI-driven knowledge/voice-search platform to manage and distribute verified brand and mall location information across search engines, maps, voice assistants (Alexa), and rideshare/GPS channels. [Yext]
deployments_detail.value: 18% YoY growth in listing clicks; 826,000+ reviews captured

deployments_detail.use: Simon+ AI-powered consumer app that helps shoppers locate the best deals and unique offers across the Simon ecosystem, both in physical centers and digitally. [Simon]

Flock Safety AI-powered automatic license plate reader (ALPR) cameras deployed across mall properties; AI creates vehicle 'fingerprints' searchable by plate, make, model, and color, with feeds shared directly with law enforcement. [Flock Safety]
